statements.status_notes: No upstream fix is published yet (advisory lists 'Fixed version: not fixed'). The lz4-java maintainers have not produced a new jar since 1.8.0 (2021-06-19) and 1.8.1 on Maven Central is metadata-only. Reachability: same as CVE-2025-12183 — bundled transitively for LZ4 decompression codecs used by kinesis-client / hadoop-common / kafka-clients / mapdb / netty-codec. Tracked for follow-up once upstream publishes a remediated binary or we substitute an alternative LZ4 implementation.

Fixed upstream in lz4-java 1.8.1 per the advisory, but the lz4-java maintainers published 1.8.1 as POM-only on Maven Central (only the .pom + .pom.sha* files are present; no .jar artifact). The last actual binary release on Maven Central is 1.8.0 (2021-06-19); the project has not produced a new jar in over four years. Reachability: lz4-java is bundled transitively for the LZ4 compression codec used by amazon-kinesis-client, hadoop-common, kafka-clients, mapdb, and netty-codec. Reachable through any data-prepper pipeline that ingests LZ4-compressed input through those connectors. Cannot be remediated without either upstream publishing a 1.8.1 binary or substituting an alternative LZ4 library — both tracked as follow-up.
